name: reference-sphere-floor
prompt: Create ONE standalone realistic lighting study for Triangle icon family. Include ONE spherical object AND its lighting effect on an implied flat horizontal receiver beneath it. Match the successful fishbowl's implied FLOOR geometry, not a poster/wall behind the object. Camera elevated parallel orthographic axonometric, looking down at floor about30degrees, no vanishing points. Object floats just above floor with a small visible air gap, same relationship for all studies. Center spherical object at about(.43,.38), diameter about.38 of square canvas; floor effect extends below and toward right, complete composition centered with generous margins. True transparent RGBA PNG outside object and its soft shadow/light pool, no visible floor rectangle or background, no horizon, no grid, labels, text, stars, frame. Intended to composite onto purple #48339a. Any emitted light pools are pale tinted transparent overlays, soft fade to alpha0, not opaque painted patches. Reference1 is the water bowl's successful floor caustic/shadow appearance ONLY for the relationship to flat floor, softness and purple-compatible colors; do not reproduce the bowl or its caustic web on opaque subjects. Reference2 gray sphere only for spherical geometry and upper-left/front illumination; remove reference white backdrop. Realistic restrained material, crisp object edges, no cartoon outlines. Canvas1254 square. A plain smooth neutral medium-gray opaque reference sphere. Broad soft upper-left/front external light, bright left/top and shaded right/bottom. Cast physically plausible compact elliptical shadow on horizontal floor under and slightly down-right45deg from sphere. Dark near-foot region, increasing blur and fading opacity farther away, enough natural grounding like the bowl. NOT a mirrored flattened image of sphere or a long poster drop shadow. No caustics or emitted light.
